input.quote: Sparkling shall pay the fees as set out in the Fee Schedule in accordance with the terms of this Agreement and the Fee Schedule.
input.rationale: No minimum purchase commitment, take-or-pay, shortfall or volume-based obligation is imposed on Sparkling. Section 11 (p0084) simply requires payment of the fees set out in the Fee Schedule; Section 2 (p0028) charges additional fees only if Sparkling elects to use the Software beyond the Authorized Locations; and maintenance under Section 10 (p0065) runs on a "renewable one-year term" rather than a locked-in multi-year commitment. Section 17(b) (p0118) additionally lets Sparkling terminate at any time on ninety (90) days' notice, so even the annual maintenance fee stream carries a clean exit. The Section 3 provisions are license scope restrictions, not volume commitments, and the only quantity limits (Authorized Locations/copies) constrain use rather than obliging us to buy. This meets the preferred position: fees are for usage or ordered services only.
